attestation: migrate to generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro This CL replaces the uses of MOCK_METHOD*() and MOCK_CONST_METHOD*() macros in unit tests with the generalized MOCK_METHOD() macro, which is now the recommended way to define mocked methods with gmock. In particular, MOCK_METHOD() supports annotating a mocked method with specifiers such as 'override'. One minor change is that argument names are omitted in the argument list provided to MOCK_METHOD() in order to prevent clang-format from formatting code like `Foo* foo` into `Foo * foo`. BUG=None TEST=Run unit tests. vm_tools: sommelier: Support for active window requests. We add support for applications to request window activation. One legitimate us of this request is to foreground a window if the user e.g. opens a file in a pre-existing window. There are two common ways for windows to request this, either directly (via NET_ACTIVE_WINDOW) or indirectly (setting the urgency flag in their NET_WM_HINTS property). The former will only work if we advertise that "active window" is supported by this WM. Currently the request does nothing (except log a message). We will handle it in a future CL. BUG=chromium:899587, chromium:978656 TEST=`sudo journalctl | grep "sommelier"` Change-Id: If9f074d5e5914a8a8e4048e8235d6c4b9b168975 Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/1824398 Tested-by: Nic Hollingum <hollingum@google.com> Commit-Ready: ChromeOS CL Exonerator Bot <chromiumos-cl-exonerator@appspot.gserviceaccount.com> Legacy-Commit-Queue: Commit Bot <commit-bot@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Fergus Dall <sidereal@google.com>
